notes: Independent validation worlds use disjoint RNG namespace from generation; selected canonical orbits uniformly without replacement.
Table covers all orbits; held out refers to new worlds, not excluding these orbits from table generation. Original formula historical training data is unknown.
Validation means are Monte Carlo estimates, not exact equity. Both raw and multiplicity-weighted metrics reported.
Noise-adjusted RMSE subtracts estimated independent validation variance, not table-generation variance; it is an estimate not a confidence guarantee.
